subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar, em textos lidos e em produções próprias, orações com a estrutura sujeito-verbo de ligação-predicativo.

components.description_pt: Identificar sujeito em oração com estrutura sujeito–verbo de ligação–predicativo do sujeito
components.description_en: Identify the subject in a clause with a subject–linking verb–predicate nominative structure
components.cc_component_description: Identify subject-verb agreement errors in written sentences

components.description_pt: Reconhecer estruturas de oração sujeito–verbo de ligação–predicativo do sujeito em textos lidos
components.description_en: Recognize subject–linking verb–predicate nominative clause structures in read texts
components.cc_component_description: Produce a complete simple sentence with a subject and predicate

components.description_pt: Aplicar corretamente estruturas de oração sujeito–verbo de ligação–predicativo do sujeito em própria escrita
components.description_en: Apply subject–linking verb–predicate nominative clause structures correctly in one's own writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply subject-verb agreement rules in complex sentence structures

cc_matches.description: Produce, expand, and rearrange complete simple and compound sentences (e.g., The boy watched the movie; The little boy watched the movie; The action movie was watched by the little boy).
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
